beats.line: That thump. Pump's still running. Okay. Still running.

beats.speaker: Christian
beats.line: Manifold first. Pressure's holding, scrubber needle is in the green. Good. Boring is good.

beats.speaker: Christian
beats.line: Watch says fifteen meters, and the nitrogen is climbing like it does every hour. Seventeen hours to decompress when I finally go up. Not today.

beats.speaker: LogRecorder
beats.line: Day one log. Diesel tank, 2000 litres, burning 2 litres an hour. Desalinator makes 20 litres of water a day. Pantry count: 700 meals. Do the math later. Math is for later.

beats.speaker: Station
beats.line: Hydrophone array, channel three, no signal.

beats.speaker: Christian
beats.line: Channel three. I wrote this firmware. Of course it's channel three. Reseat the bus, clear the fault, don't take it personally.

beats.speaker: Christian
beats.line: Intake bulkhead valve is seized. Zebra mussels, probably. Manual crank, then.

beats.speaker: Christian
beats.line: Come on. Come on. There. It's moving. Slow and steady, nobody's timing me.

beats.speaker: Christian
beats.line: Okay. Look up. Just once. ...They're still up there. Hundreds of them, blocking the light. Not coming down. They can't come down.

beats.speaker: LogRecorder
beats.line: End of entry. Lab 04 is stable. Supply boat comes in three weeks. I just have to keep the lights on until then.
